The HL7/fhir source/best-practices.html file is only a core best-practices index using <%best-practice-list%>, not the IG guidance narrative.
reconciliation: No HL7/fhir source was changed. The requested correction belongs to, and has already been made in, the external FHIR/ig-guidance source repository.
